induction.iteration_start: At B3 before iteration i+1, RAX=S+i,R10D=i,RDX=D-S,R8=-S; accessible disjoint memory keeps original future source bytes.
induction.copy: B3 loads source[i]; B6 increments count; B9 writes destination[i]; BC advances source pointer. No first/current-byte NUL test precedes copy.
induction.count: C0 computes i+1 via (-S)+(S+i+1); C4/C7 compare that positive offset against signed c. If i+1>=c, exit before any next-byte read.
induction.next_byte: Only when i+1<c, C9 reads source[i+1]; CC continues iff nonzero. Therefore the earliest examined zero is q>=1, regardless source[0].
induction.bound: M=max(1,c),1<=M<=INT32_MAX. Either next-byte zero stops at q<M or count stops at M; I=min(q,M). If no q before M, I=M. Counter stays1..INT32_MAX, so signed count never wraps.
induction.exit: CE signextends copied count, D1 writes destination[I]=0, D6 zeroes EAX (rawRAX0), D8 returns. NULL branch A0 zeroextends EAXFFFFFFFF to rawRAX00000000FFFFFFFF and A3 returns without destination writes.

symbolic_partitions.q: c..infinity or no zero before c
